goal: The user has the work that the AI they instruct leaves run as far as it can, stopped by no reason other than its own content: 「AI が置いた作業が、使用枠の上限、質問待ち、会話の終了といった中身以外の理由で止まらずに、できるだけ実行される。」「A」 Once it holds, that AI, whether it calls overnight itself or through another plugin, leaves pieces of work that go on through the usage limit, with no prompt waiting for an answer, and after the session that left them ends, until only their own content stops them, where before such a reason stopped them.

deliverable.name: overnight's developers know whom overnight serves and the one way it keeps the work left to it running as far as it can

decisions.decided: One role: the AI that the user instructs, whether it calls overnight itself or through another plugin. A plugin that calls overnight is that AI's way of calling it, and has no objective or key result of its own: 「ユーザーがAIに指示して、AIが段取る、なので利用者はAI」「Aをプラグインで呼び出したら同じだよね？」

The objective is that the work the user left runs as far as it can, not that it gets done, as whether a piece gets done depends on its content. It names no night or morning, and holds no taking in of the results: 「できるだけ実行されること、なのでは？」「最後までかどうかは作業次第だよね、、、」「夜とか朝とかどうでもよい、できるだけ実行、これが目的」

One key result alone: the share of the pieces left to overnight that stop for a reason other than their own content, such as the usage limit, waiting for an answer to a prompt, or the session being closed. Lower is better. No key result counts the steps the user takes, and none counts whether a piece succeeds or reaches its end, as that depends on its content: 「良し悪しの測り方 違うのでは？ 中身次第の内容を省くと？ できるだけ実行されること、なのでは？ 意図の内容ってそういうことでは？」「最後までかどうかは作業次第だよね、、、」「A なのでロジックだよね」

decisions.about: an objective for taking in the results
decisions.decided: No objective for taking in the results: the one objective and its one key result stand alone, as results follow from running: 「結果を受け取れるかどうかが目的でなく、できるだけ実行するかどうか、が本質的な目的 実行できれば結果がついてくる 夜とか朝とかどうでもよい、できるだけ実行、これが目的 イメージできますか？」 「AI が置いた作業が、使用枠の上限、質問待ち、会話の終了といった中身以外の理由で止まらずに、できるだけ実行される。」「A」

decisions.about: who decides the one way and its ideas
decisions.decided: The maker decides the one way and each idea that carries it from the goal and the run's records, and asks the user none of them, as the user confirms only the purpose and the intent: 「目的はすでに伝えてるよね？ それ手段だよね？」 「私は目的と意図だけ確認したい、使い方や実装に興味ない、実現して欲しい」

decisions.about: what the one way and its ideas serve
decisions.decided: The one way and each idea of the concept serve the key result, keeping pieces from stopping for a reason other than their content, and the one way promises no piece its end: 「意図の内容ってそういうことでは？」「最後までかどうかは作業次第だよね、、、」

decisions.about: a piece that the usage limit stops again and again
decisions.decided: The concept holds no idea of giving a piece up: such a piece waits out each reset like any other piece.

- Waiting out the usage limit, for O1\
A piece that the limit stops goes on after each reset, however often the limit comes back.
- Nothing to answer, for O1\
Each piece gets its tools and a folder of its own up front, so no prompt waits for an answer.
- Running past the session, for O1\
Each piece goes on after the session that left it closes.
- Several pieces at once, each on its own, for O1\
A piece that waits holds back no other, so each piece starts that night.
- A morning record of each piece, for O1\
The user reads how far each piece ran and what stopped it, and takes in what it made.
